title: Looking for destroyed stuff for MZ

posts.author: Wariosbiggestfan
posts.body:
Im working on my little rpg project, and the first sort of intended quest is to go find out what happened to a convoy of merchants, in classic fashion its completely ruined and destroyed, so sprites for destroyed wagons, bodies, etc would be nice. im mostly using rpg maker resources, but I dont mind editing things to make them a bit more cohesive, preferably the style wouldnt be too far off, dont want hyper realistic HL2 dead person things as an example. but I eventually plan to reskin my whole game with my own assets after the first section is done, and now im rambling so im gonna shut up.
TLDR, looking for ruined wagons and broken chests and stuff like that.
(if youve read this before this is a repost in a more fitting spot)
